title: Dry-Spiced Aloo Gobi with Cumin and Tomato
summary: Potatoes and cauliflower are browned separately, then steamed in an onion, ginger, garlic and tomato masala and finished with garam masala, lemon and coriander.
equipment: large deep frying pan or sauté pan with lid

ingredients.item: waxy potatoes (such as Charlotte or Maris Peer)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Brown the potatoes
steps.text: Fry the potatoes in 3 tbsp oil over medium heat 8-10 minutes until golden in spots. Lift out.

steps.title: Brown the cauliflower
steps.text: Add the remaining oil and the cauliflower and cook 5 minutes until browned in spots. Lift out.

steps.title: Build the masala
steps.text: Sizzle the cumin seeds, then cook the onion and chilli until golden. Add the garlic and ginger, then the ground spices.

steps.title: Add tomatoes
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and salt and cook 4-5 minutes to a thick paste.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Return the vegetables with 80 ml water, cover and cook on low 12-15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Uncover and cook 2 minutes on higher heat, then fold in the garam masala, lemon juice and coriander.

tips: Browning the vegetables first stops them turning mushy in the masala.
Stir gently so the cauliflower keeps its shape.
Waxy potatoes hold their cubes; floury ones crumble.
storage: Cool quickly, cover and refrigerate within 2 hours. Eat within 3 days, reheated until piping hot (75 °C in the centre).
